# sigma_folder (Resource)

Manages a Sigma folder through the files API. Create always sends the folder request variant (`type = folder`). Importing or refreshing a non-folder inode is an error. Workbook source-copy and restore are not supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sigma_folder" "example" {
  name        = "Terraform Managed"
  parent_id   = sigma_workspace.example.id
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Folder name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Folder description.
- `owner_id` (String) Member ID of the folder owner.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent folder or workspace inode ID.

### Read-Only

- `badge` (String) Badge applied to the folder. Null when Sigma reports no badge.
- `created_at` (String) Folder creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) ID of the member who created the folder.
- `id` (String) Inode ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the folder is archived.
- `parent_source_url_id` (String) Source document URL ID for a tenant deployment.
- `parent_url_id` (String) Parent identifier used in Sigma URLs.
- `path` (String) Folder path.
- `permission` (String) Effective permission.
- `updated_at` (String) Folder update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) ID of the member who last updated the folder.
- `url_id` (String) Identifier used in Sigma URLs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_folder.example inode-id
```
